note: Property-related taxes. The state fastighetsskatt on homes was abolished in 2008 and replaced by the capped kommunal fastighetsavgift: 0.75 % of taxeringsvärde, at most 10,425 kr for small houses (income year 2026 / declaration 2027; the cap is indexed). The two house examples refer explicitly to tax assessment values, not market prices; both are above the 1.39 million threshold for the cap. OECD Revenue Statistics 2024, data for 2022: taxes on property (a broad category including recurrent property taxes, wealth/inheritance taxes and transaction taxes) were 0.9 % of GDP in Sweden; an unweighted EU-15 mean calculated from the country table is about 2.1 %. Ränteavdrag: 30 % of a capital deficit up to 100,000 kr/yr, 21 % above.
